Create a reusable analytic named Disconnect sequence one_link. Read the whole imported recording. Group disconnect requests by device and network. Look for EAPOL within 30000 milliseconds after a disconnect. Separate episodes when the gap exceeds 3000 milliseconds. Report a matching sequence when at least 1 episodes have related EAPOL. Otherwise report that the sequence threshold was not met. Keep addresses configurable and do not claim an attack is proven.

This does not establish malicious intent or a completed reconnect.\",\"when\":{\"step\":\"target_behavior\",\"metric\":\"linked_episodes\",\"atLeast\":1},\"label\":\"MATCHING SEQUENCE\"},{\"verdict\":\"REVIEW POSTURE\",\"summary\":\"The selected sequence threshold was not met in this recording; missing observations do not establish safety.\",\"when\":{\"always\":true},\"label\":\"SEQUENCE THRESHOLD NOT MET\"}]}"}}],"edges":[{"from":"capture_source","to":"target_behavior.frames","carries":"frames"},{"from":"target_behavior","to":"verdict.features","carries":"feature"}]}}
